extracted_from: field_classification.md Category C (19 fields imperatively set as CIR rule activation side-effects)
purpose: Fields populated as side-effects of Conditional Integration Rule (CIR) activation. Each CIR has an actions[] array; when its trigger fires, the engine assigns the listed values to these fields. They are NOT Phase 1 nodes nor mandatory always-on configuration — they are conditional outputs of cross-method coordination logic.

fields.trigger_summary: future operating year OR TRL < 7 OR analysis period or asset lifetime > 15y
fields.notes: Activates dynamic SSP/RCP background scenarios across LCA + LCC.

fields.trigger_summary: future operating year OR TRL < 7 OR analysis period or asset lifetime > 15y
fields.notes: LCC counterpart of lca.background_futurisation; same SSP/RCP scenario family for cross-method coherence.

fields.trigger_summary: Q2 = B (ex-ante: the exchanges do not take place yet)
fields.notes: Pedigree Matrix scoring activated for LCA when ex-ante data is in use.

fields.trigger_summary: Q2 = B (ex-ante: the exchanges do not take place yet)
fields.notes: Pedigree Matrix scoring activated for LCC; matches LCA per CIR-02.
GIS-coupled spatial modeling for LCA transport / location-sensitive flows.
GIS-coupled cost computation for LCC; matches LCA per CIR-03.
S-LCA territorial dimension coupled to spatial GIS layer; relates to slca.territorial_dimension (set by slca_hc_10) but is a runtime coupling artifact, not a node config.

fields.trigger_summary: Q1=B AND network_nodes >= 3 AND interdependent_flows == true
fields.notes: Percolation theory, the recommended way to identify the critical nodes (D4.2 §10.3, L01235). The trigger reads network_nodes and interdependent_flows, which Case does not have (I-17), so CIR-04 never fires; if it did, it would overwrite lcc_mc_16 (node-removal scenario for each critical node, L01237) with the identification method alone.

DUAL-SOURCE FIELD (Mirko design call, field_gaps round 2): node default ('ReCiPe 2016 hierarchic + EF 3.1 backup') is set by lca_mc_25; CIR-05 overrides to 'EF_3.1' when Q4=D for PEF compliance. Read order at runtime: node default first, CIR override last.
Net Transfer Function allocation; CIR-05 side-effect distinct from the primary lcc.allocation_method node field (set by lcc_hc_10/lcc_mc_07).

CE Delft EU shadow prices for externality monetization in PEF-aligned reports, written only when the case has the environmental dimension: without a parallel LCA there is nothing to monetise (2026-10-15). Otherwise lcc_mc_19 decides (mandatory in the S-LCC).

List of the frontier impact categories of D4.1 §10.3.5 (marine litter and plastic leakage, biochar and soil carbon, iLUC, microplastic fibre shedding) reported where the network implicates the flow (lca_hc_19).
LCC externality categories matched to lca.frontier_categories. Cross-method coherence via CIR-06.

fields.trigger_summary: frontier_categories_active OR (Q1 in {B,C} AND IS-specific capital goods AND Q3.SOC active)
fields.notes: S-LCA indicators set adapted to: (1) sector frontier categories via CIR-06; (2) shared CAPEX stakeholder-group indicators via CIR-08.

fields.default_value_when_set: Stoichiometric recalculation|Lang-factor equipment mapping|Batch-to-continuous conversion|Learning curves
fields.notes: Inventory scale-up techniques of D4.1 §9.3.5 (L01104-L01110) for a technology below TRL 7, the same list lca_mc_20 names. Six-Tenths and CEPCI are D4.2 cost tools and stay on lcc.scale_up_framework (2026-10-15).

DUAL-SOURCE FIELD (Mirko design call, field_gaps round 2): node default is set by lcc_hc_15 when Q6b<=TRL7; CIR-07 writes the D4.2 cost tools (Six-Tenths rule, Lang factors, CEPCI, D4.2 §7.3, L00877-L00881); the LCA gets the D4.1 inventory techniques instead (2026-10-15). Read order at runtime: node default first, CIR override last.

Event triggers that activate the iterative update protocol on the case object. Distinct from other CIR outputs in that it lives under case.* prefix (not pillar-specific) because the protocol is case-level, not method-level.
